description: Use this when someone plans a wheelchair ramp or an accessible ramp and asks how long it must be or whether it meets the ADA or a building rule. Calculates a ramp that climbs a height in equal runs with level landings: the slope, the number and length of the runs, the landings, the length with landings and the floor space, straight or as a switchback, checked against a ramp rule. Without a slope, it finds the shortest ramp the rule allows. Rules: ada2010 (United States, 2010 ADA Standards), admHomes (England, Approved Document M, M4(2) dwellings), admBuildings (England, Approved Document M, other buildings), din18040 (Germany), cte (Spain, CTE DB-SUA accessible route).

layout.description: Straight, or a switchback that turns back at each landing; straight when left out.

rise.description: Height the ramp climbs, in millimeters.

rules.description: The ramp rule of the country and building type.

slope.description: Slope of every run, rise over going, such as 0.0625 for 1:16; without it, the shortest ramp the rule allows.

width.description: Clear width of the ramp; the rule's minimum when left out, in millimeters.

name: calculate_ramp
title: Ramp calculator
